TUYA.NAME: Tuya devices
TUYA.DESCRIPTION: Tuya Wi-Fi devices (LSC Smart Connect, Smart Life, Tuya Smart) through the local protocol on the LAN, no cloud

SCAN.NAME: Search devices
SCAN.DESCRIPTION: Lists the Tuya devices that announce themselves on the network and are not configured yet. Enter the local key of each one afterwards

PLUG.NAME: Smart plug
PLUG.DESCRIPTION: A Tuya smart plug with power meter (e.g. LSC Power Plug w/ Power Meter)

HOST.NAME: Device address
HOST.DESCRIPTION: IP address of the plug, e.g. 192.168.1.50. Give the plug a fixed address in the router

DEVICE_ID.NAME: Device ID
DEVICE_ID.DESCRIPTION: Tuya device id (22 characters), filled in by the search or shown in the app under device information

LOCAL_KEY.NAME: Local key
LOCAL_KEY.DESCRIPTION: 16 characters, from the Tuya IoT platform (project linked to your app account → API Explorer → Query Device Details, field local_key). Changes when the plug is paired again

VERSION.NAME: Protocol version
VERSION.DESCRIPTION: 3.3 or 3.4, filled in by the search

POLL.NAME: Polling interval [s]
POLL.DESCRIPTION: How often the status is read. Switching in the app or with the button arrives at once

CONNECTED.NAME: Connected
CONNECTED.DESCRIPTION: The local session with the plug is open

ENERGY_ADDED.NAME: Energy added [kWh]
ENERGY_ADDED.DESCRIPTION: Energy counter of the plug (DP 17); it may restart, link it to a meter logic for a running total

COUNTDOWN.NAME: Countdown [s]
COUNTDOWN.DESCRIPTION: Seconds until the plug toggles by itself, 0 = off. Can be written

POWER_ON_STATE.NAME: State after power loss
POWER_ON_STATE.DESCRIPTION: off, on or memory (as set in the app)
